summary: Northern Dynasty Minerals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, announcing notice-and-access delivery of proxy materials for its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for June 24, 2026. Shareholders are to vote on auditor appointment, director elections, and share option plan unallocated entitlements. This is a routine shareholder meeting notice; no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a standard Canadian issuer reporting obligation under the 1934 Act via 6-K.
